2608.04472.title: EndoVLM: An Endoscopy Vision-Language Pre-training Model via Anatomy-Guided Sparsity and Progressive Alignment
2608.04472.paper_summary: The development of foundation models (FMs) is crucial for advancing endoscopic image analysis. However, existing endoscopy FMs mainly rely on self-supervised learning from uni-modal images or videos, overlooking the rich semantic knowledge contained in clinical reports. Furthermore, effectively leveraging these records is hindered by a fundamental modality gap: structured anatomical descriptions are not naturally mapped to specific frames within the high-redundancy, uncurated visual streams. In this paper, we present EndoVLM, a novel vision-language FM pre-trained on over 348K endoscopic examinations, each pairing a clinical report with its corresponding image collection. An Anatomy-Guided Sparse Pooling mechanism utilizes textual descriptions as queries to drive sparse attention, efficiently aggregating semantically salient frames into anatomy-specific visual representations across redundant image-sets. Next, a Progressive Semantic-Aware Alignment strategy models clinical taxonomy (anatomy and pathological status) via structured soft targets, bridging the gap from global patient-level matching to fine-grained localized alignment. Finally, a Semantic-Concentrated Masked Autoencoder is applied exclusively to these semantic-rich frames, integrating low-level visual precision with robust high-level semantic representation. Extensive experiments across various downstream tasks demonstrate that EndoVLM outperforms existing foundation models and remains competitive with task-specific methods. Remarkably, EndoVLM also exhibits robust zero-shot generalization capabilities, highlighting its potential for broader clinical application.
2608.04472.paper_summary_zh: 基礎模型（FMs）的發展對於推進內窺鏡影像分析至關重要。<lb/>然而，現有的內窺鏡FMs主要依賴於從單一模態影像或視頻中進行自我監督學習，忽略了臨床報告中所包含的豐富語義知識。<lb/>此外，有效利用這些記錄受到基本模態差距的阻礙：結構化的解剖描述並不自然地映射到高冗餘、未經整理的視覺流中的特定幀。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了EndoVLM，一種新穎的視覺-語言FM，經過超過348K內窺鏡檢查的預訓練，每個檢查都將臨床報告與其對應的影像集合配對。<lb/>一種解剖引導的稀疏池化機制利用文本描述作為查詢來驅動稀疏注意力，將語義上顯著的幀有效地聚合成解剖特定的視覺表示，跨越冗餘影像集。<lb/>接下來，一種漸進式語義感知對齊策略通過結構化的軟目標建模臨床分類（解剖學和病理狀態），將全球患者級匹配與細粒度局部對齊之間的差距橋接起來。<lb/>最後，語義集中型掩碼自編碼器專門應用於這些語義豐富的幀，將低級視覺精度與強大的高級語義表示相結合。<lb/>在各種下游任務中的廣泛實驗表明，EndoVLM的表現超過現有的基礎模型，並且在任務特定方法中保持競爭力。<lb/>值得注意的是，EndoVLM還展現出強大的零樣本泛化能力，突顯了其在更廣泛臨床應用中的潛力。
